input_fields.name: upstream_operation
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `operation_id` and `outputs`; operation_id identifies one upstream instance.

input_fields.name: downstream_operation
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `operation_id` and `inputs`; operation_id identifies one downstream instance.

input_fields.name: required_artifact_or_state
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `name`, `kind`, and `reason` for the one artifact or state that must flow.

input_fields.name: existing_dependency_edges
input_fields.description: Array of edge objects, each with required keys `upstream_id`, `downstream_id`, and `artifact_or_state`, used only for duplicate and cycle checks.

result_fields.name: dependency_edge
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `upstream_id`, `downstream_id`, `artifact_or_state`, and `rationale`; nullable when the common output envelope records insufficient dependency evidence.

procedure: Verify that the two operation identities are distinct and that their declared outputs and inputs are available for comparison.
Match the required artifact or state to a concrete upstream output and downstream prerequisite.
Check the directed edge against existing edges for duplication and cycles, without adding unrelated ordering constraints.
Return `dependency_edge` as action data and place status, provenance ownership, and any unresolved fields in the common output envelope.
rejection_rules: Reject an edge justified only by visual order, stage labels, or convenience rather than a required artifact or state.
Reject self-edges, cycles, duplicate edges, and operation identities that are not explicit.
Do not turn a dependency edge into a complete recipe or hidden operation sequence.
